title: Teleporter and Waypoints
description: Lets you teleport to different Spots with one click
body:
**# Teleporter & Waypoints**

_## Quality of Life Datapack_

This Datapack lets you craft a Teleporter and Waypoints.

### Teleporter:
By shift-clicking you can select a spot and when you click without shift,
you teleport to it.

### Waypoints:
Shift clicking places the Waypoint and regular right click
teleports you to the nearest Waypoint.

Crafting Recipes are in the Gallery
